title: Individuals of C. elegans growing in micro chambers
legend: Individual animals of C. elegans were recorded simultaneously in arrayed micro chambers from birth to adulthood at a time resolution of 10 minutes.

title: Worm race
legend: Individuals of C. elegans were imaged every 10 minutes throughout their development and computationally straightened. green marks the pharynx, red the total body.

title: Germline growth
legend: The two gonadal arms of the germline of C. elegans was marked GFP and imaged from birth to adulthood.

title: chewing worm
legend: The pharynx of a worm was imaged at 30 frames per second to visualize the movements of the pharyngeal muscle. Movie plays in real time.

title: reproducing worms
legend: Single animal was imaged hourly over 7 days. Eggs were genetically prevented from hatching to count progeny.

title: singaling dynamics
legend: An animal expressing the transcription factor DAF-16:GFP is shown. DAF-16 shuttles in and out of th nucleus when activated.
